questions.topic: 专项练习 · Topic 25 · 第 8 题
questions.paper: 04 Geometry and Trigonometry 专项练习（重录）
questions.hint: 等腰 △RTU 底角 33；外角 x=31+33
questions.stem: In the figure above, RT = TU. What is the value of x?

figSpec.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 440 300' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' font-family='Times New Roman,Georgia,serif'><line x1='80' y1='240' x2='380' y2='240' stroke='#162c46' stroke-width='2'/><line x1='120' y1='70' x2='380' y2='240' stroke='#162c46' stroke-width='2'/><line x1='80' y1='240' x2='230' y2='150' stroke='#162c46' stroke-width='2'/><line x1='230' y1='150' x2='250' y2='240' stroke='#162c46' stroke-width='2'/><circle cx='250' cy='240' r='3' fill='#0f2a47'/><text x='114' y='62' font-size='16' fill='#162c46'>S</text><text x='72' y='262' font-size='16' fill='#162c46'>R</text><text x='386' y='262' font-size='16' fill='#162c46'>U</text><text x='236' y='146' font-size='16' fill='#162c46'>T</text><text x='244' y='262' font-size='16' fill='#162c46'>V</text><text x='140' y='120' font-size='14' fill='#162c46'>31°</text><text x='238' y='178' font-size='14' fill='#162c46'>114°</text><text x='238' y='232' font-size='14' fill='#162c46'>x°</text></svg>

ledger.recompute: △STU：∠TUS=180-114-31=35；RT=TU → △RTU 等腰，顶角 ∠RTU=114，底角 ∠TUR=33；外角定理 x=∠VSU+∠SUV=31+33=64。Numerade/Testbook 答案 64 复核一致。

questions.topic: 专项练习 · Topic 25 · 第 9 题
questions.paper: 04 Geometry and Trigonometry 专项练习（重录）
questions.stem: In the figure, RT = TU, the measure of angle VST is 24°, and the measure of angle RVS is 41°. What is the value of x?

figSpec.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 440 300' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' font-family='Times New Roman,Georgia,serif'><line x1='60' y1='250' x2='380' y2='250' stroke='#162c46' stroke-width='2'/><line x1='60' y1='250' x2='330' y2='70' stroke='#162c46' stroke-width='2'/><line x1='250' y1='250' x2='330' y2='70' stroke='#162c46' stroke-width='2'/><line x1='380' y1='250' x2='250' y2='250' stroke='#162c46' stroke-width='2'/><line x1='380' y1='250' x2='180' y2='160' stroke='#162c46' stroke-width='2'/><circle cx='180' cy='160' r='3' fill='#0f2a47'/><text x='52' y='272' font-size='16' fill='#162c46'>U</text><text x='244' y='272' font-size='16' fill='#162c46'>V</text><text x='386' y='272' font-size='16' fill='#162c46'>R</text><text x='324' y='62' font-size='16' fill='#162c46'>S</text><text x='172' y='154' font-size='16' fill='#162c46'>T</text><text x='172' y='186' font-size='14' fill='#162c46'>x°</text></svg>

ledger.recompute: △USV 外角 ∠RVS=41=∠SUV(α)+∠VSU=α+24 → α=17。RT=TU → △RTU 等腰，∠TRU=∠TUR=α=17；x=∠RTU=180-2×17=146。同型 29/41 版 x=156=(180-2×12) 链条验证一致。

questions.topic: 专项练习 · Topic 25 · 第 10 题
questions.paper: 04 Geometry and Trigonometry 专项练习（重录）
questions.hint: 已有两角，需对应边 BC=EF（ASA）
questions.stem: In triangles ABC and DEF, angles B and E each have measure 27° and angles C and F each have measure 41°. Which additional piece of information is sufficient to determine whether triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF?

choices.C: The lengths of sides BC and EF

ledger.recompute: 两角相等仅得相似；C 给出对应边 BC 与 EF 的长度（夹在 27°、41° 之间），可判 ASA 全等。Gauth 专家答案 C 复核一致。

questions.topic: 专项练习 · Topic 25 · 第 11 题
questions.paper: 04 Geometry and Trigonometry 专项练习（重录）
questions.hint: 两角已定，第三角自动相等，AA 即可
questions.stem: In triangle DEF, the measure of angle D is 46° and the measure of angle E is 99°. In triangle RST, the measure of angle R is 46° and the measure of angle S is 99°. Which of the following additional pieces of information is needed to determine whether triangle DEF is similar to triangle RST?

choices.C: The measure of angle F and the measure of angle T

ledger.recompute: ∠D=∠R=46、∠E=∠S=99，第三角 ∠F=∠T=35 自动推出，AA 相似无需补充信息。

questions.topic: 专项练习 · Topic 25 · 第 14 题
questions.paper: 04 Geometry and Trigonometry 专项练习（重录）
questions.hint: 对应角相等，2XY=RS 为干扰
questions.stem: Triangle XYZ is similar to triangle RST such that X, Y, and Z correspond to R, S, and T, respectively. The measure of angle Z is 20° and 2XY = RS. What is the measure of angle T, in degree ?

ledger.recompute: Z↔T 对应，相似三角形对应角相等，∠T=∠Z=20；2XY=RS 是边长干扰。

questions.topic: 专项练习 · Topic 25 · 第 15 题
questions.paper: 04 Geometry and Trigonometry 专项练习（重录）
questions.hint: S↔Z 对应，角相等；边长为干扰
questions.stem: Quadrilaterals PQRS and WXYZ are similar, where P, Q, and R correspond to W, X, and Y, respectively. The measure of angle S is 120°, PS = 40, and WZ = 8. What is the measure of angle Z, in degree ?

ledger.recompute: S 与 Z 对应（P,Q,R↔W,X,Y），对应角相等，∠Z=∠S=120；PS/WZ 为边长干扰。

questions.topic: 专项练习 · Topic 25 · 第 16 题
questions.paper: 04 Geometry and Trigonometry 专项练习（重录）
questions.hint: 相似保角，缩放比 k 不影响角度
questions.stem: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle XYZ, where A and B correspond to X and Y respectively. The length of each side of triangle XYZ is k times the length of its corresponding side in triangle ABC, where k is an integer greater than 1. The measure, in degrees, of angle Z can be represented by the expression 8x + 27, where x is an integer. Which of the following expressions represents the measure, in degrees, of angle C for all possible values of x?

ledger.recompute: 相似三角形对应角相等，C↔Z，k 只缩放边长；∠C=∠Z=8x+27。
